senses.en: to hold someone's attention completely
senses.pattern: be absorbed in a book / be completely absorbed in / absorb sb's attention
senses.example: The puzzle so [[absorbed]] the children that they did not notice their mother come home.
senses.example_zh: 那個拼圖讓孩子們全神貫注，連媽媽回到家都沒發現。
senses.note: absorbing (adj.) 引人入勝的

senses.en: to cope with costs, losses, or shocks
senses.pattern: absorb the cost / absorb losses / absorb the shock
senses.example: Small shops cannot [[absorb]] rising rents for long, so many have already raised their prices.
senses.example_zh: 小店無法長期承受不斷上漲的租金，所以許多店家已經調漲價格。

senses.en: a statement admitting that something is true
senses.pattern: an admission of guilt / an admission of failure / by one's own admission
senses.example: His silence during the meeting was taken as an [[admission]] that the mistake had been his.
senses.example_zh: 他在會議上的沉默被視為承認那個錯誤是他犯的。
senses.note: 動詞 admit；an admission of guilt 認罪

senses.en: the price charged to enter a place
senses.pattern: free admission / charge admission / half-price admission
senses.example: The museum charges adults ten dollars for [[admission]], but children under six get in free.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館向成人收取十美元的入場費，但六歲以下兒童免費入場。

gsat.sentence: [[Admission]] is free for people young and old.

senses.en: to start to use a method, plan, or idea
senses.pattern: adopt a method / adopt a new approach / adopt a policy
senses.example: After several complaints, the school decided to [[adopt]] a new approach to teaching math.
senses.example_zh: 接到幾次投訴後，學校決定採用新的數學教學方法。
senses.note: 名詞為 adoption

senses.en: to formally accept a proposal by voting
senses.pattern: adopt a resolution / adopt a proposal / be adopted unanimously
senses.example: The student council [[adopted]] the proposal to ban plastic straws by a vote of twenty to three.
senses.example_zh: 學生會以二十票對三票正式通過了禁用塑膠吸管的提案。

gsat.sentence: Systems using movable arms were popular in Chicago, while those using the red and green lights were [[adopted]] in San Francisco.
Over the years, the fearless tribesmen have stood strong against slavery, and resisted the urging of the Kenyan and Tanzanian governments to [[adopt]] a more modern lifestyle.

senses.en: a chemical or substance that produces a particular effect
senses.pattern: a cleaning agent / a chemical agent / a bleaching agent
senses.example: Bleach is a powerful cleaning [[agent]], so always wear gloves and open the windows when using it.
senses.example_zh: 漂白水是強效的清潔劑，所以使用時務必戴上手套並打開窗戶。

senses.en: a person or thing that causes a change
senses.pattern: an agent of change / an agent for change / agents of social change
senses.example: Teachers can be powerful [[agents]] of change in communities where few children finish school.
senses.example_zh: 在很少孩子能完成學業的社區裡，老師可以成為促成改變的重要推手。

senses.en: strange and unfamiliar; very different from what you know
senses.pattern: be alien to sb / an alien culture / an alien environment
senses.example: City life felt [[alien]] to the young farmer, who missed the quiet fields of his hometown.
senses.example_zh: 對這位年輕農夫來說，都市生活十分陌生，他很想念家鄉寧靜的田野。

senses.en: a person who is not a citizen of the country
senses.pattern: a resident alien / a legal alien / the rights of aliens
senses.example: Under the old law, any [[alien]] who stayed longer than ninety days had to register with the police.
senses.example_zh: 依照舊法，凡是停留超過九十天的外國人都必須向警方登記。
senses.note: 法律用語；日常多說 foreigner

senses.en: (of a plan) needing great effort, money, or skill to succeed
senses.pattern: an ambitious plan / an ambitious project / an overly ambitious goal
senses.example: Building a tunnel under the sea was an [[ambitious]] project that took engineers over twenty years to finish.
senses.example_zh: 興建海底隧道是一項宏大艱鉅的工程，工程師花了二十多年才完成。
senses.note: 此義修飾事物（計畫、目標），非修飾人

gsat.sentence: A triumph for medical technology, Oddsson’s fish skin transplantation was actually part of the astonishing achievement of “100% Fish,” an [[ambitious]] task in promoting environmental efficiency.
Medvedev Vladimir, 43, and his son, Maxsine, 14, sailed from an unnamed eastern Russian seaport on August 18, to begin an [[ambitious]] around-the-world cruise.

senses.en: a person you work or do business with
senses.pattern: a business associate / a close associate / a former associate
senses.example: The detective interviewed several business [[associates]] of the missing banker, but none had seen him lately.
senses.example_zh: 警探約談了失蹤銀行家的幾位生意夥伴，但最近都沒有人見過他。
senses.note: 名詞字尾讀作 /ɪt/；associate professor 副教授

senses.en: to spend time with someone
senses.pattern: associate with / refuse to associate with / associate freely with
senses.example: His parents warned him not to [[associate]] with classmates who often skipped school.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母告誡他，不要和經常蹺課的同學來往。

senses.en: something good that you are grateful for
senses.pattern: a blessing in disguise / a mixed blessing / count your blessings
senses.example: The heavy rain was a [[blessing]] for farmers whose fields had been dry for months.
senses.example_zh: 對田地乾旱了好幾個月的農民來說，這場大雨真是件幸事。
senses.note: a blessing in disguise＝因禍得福

senses.en: approval of or permission for something
senses.pattern: with sb's blessing / give sth your blessing / have the blessing of
senses.example: With her parents' [[blessing]], Amy left her office job to open a small bakery.
senses.example_zh: 在父母的同意下，艾咪辭去辦公室的工作，開了一家小麵包店。

gsat.sentence: “The [[blessing]] that Morgan has brought is beyond anything that I ever could have imagined and could explain.”

senses.en: the official position or role that someone has
senses.pattern: in one's capacity as / in an official capacity / in a personal capacity
senses.example: She attended the meeting in her [[capacity]] as chair of the student council, not as a friend.
senses.example_zh: 她是以學生會主席的身分出席這場會議，而不是以朋友的身分。

senses.en: the amount that a factory or machine can produce
senses.pattern: at full capacity / production capacity / increase capacity
senses.example: The factory has been running at full [[capacity]] since orders for the new bicycle started pouring in.
senses.example_zh: 自從新款自行車的訂單大量湧入後，這家工廠就一直以最大產能運轉。

senses.en: to promise or give yourself fully to something
senses.pattern: be committed to + N/V-ing / commit oneself to / commit to a plan
senses.example: The city has [[committed]] itself to cutting plastic waste in half within ten years.
senses.example_zh: 該市承諾在十年內將塑膠垃圾減半。
senses.note: to 為介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

senses.en: to use money, time, or people for a purpose
senses.pattern: commit money to / commit resources to / commit time to
senses.example: The company will [[commit]] half of its annual budget to developing cleaner engines.
senses.example_zh: 該公司將把年度預算的一半投入研發更乾淨的引擎。

gsat.sentence: They are [[committed]] to glorifying their parents.
The non-profit organization has [[committed]] $1 million over five years to finance the construction of the medical center.

senses.en: to form or make up a whole
senses.pattern: be composed of / be composed mainly of / be composed entirely of
senses.example: Water is [[composed]] of hydrogen and oxygen, two gases that are invisible at room temperature.
senses.example_zh: 水由氫和氧組成，這兩種氣體在室溫下都看不見。
senses.note: 常用被動：be composed of

senses.en: to make yourself calm and controlled
senses.pattern: compose yourself / compose your thoughts / pause to compose yourself
senses.example: She took a deep breath to [[compose]] herself before walking onto the stage to speak.
senses.example_zh: 她深吸一口氣使自己鎮定下來，然後才走上台演講。
senses.note: composed（adj.）鎮定的

gsat.sentence: The names were chosen from a name pool [[composed]] of 140 names, 10 each from the 14 members of the committee.
The new expansion is [[composed]] of five themed splash pads and a River Boat Adventure Ride.

senses.en: to harm or weaken something; to put it at risk
senses.pattern: compromise safety / compromise security / compromise one's health / compromise the quality of sth
senses.example: Using cheap materials to save money could [[compromise]] the safety of the entire bridge.
senses.example_zh: 為了省錢而使用廉價材料，可能會危及整座橋的安全。

senses.en: to go against your principles or lower your standards
senses.pattern: compromise one's principles / compromise one's standards / compromise one's beliefs
senses.example: The reporter refused to [[compromise]] her principles by accepting gifts from the people she wrote about.
senses.example_zh: 那位記者拒絕違背自己的原則，不肯收受報導對象的禮物。

senses.en: to solve a difficult problem or break a code
senses.pattern: crack a code / crack a case / crack the problem
senses.example: It took the detective three months to [[crack]] the case of the stolen painting.
senses.example_zh: 那位偵探花了三個月才偵破這起名畫失竊案。

senses.en: to lose control because of great pressure
senses.pattern: crack under pressure / crack under the strain / finally crack
senses.example: Some students [[crack]] under the pressure of exams, so schools now offer free counseling.
senses.example_zh: 有些學生在考試壓力下崩潰，因此學校現在提供免費諮商。

senses.en: a method used to produce a particular effect
senses.pattern: a literary device / a rhetorical device / a marketing device / a plot device
senses.example: Repeating a key phrase is a simple [[device]] that speakers use to make their message stick.
senses.example_zh: 重複關鍵語句是演講者用來讓訊息深植人心的簡單手法。

gsat.sentence: Many women report that the henna crowns really work as a healing [[device]], helping them build a more positive self-image at a time when they are vulnerable and depressed.

senses.en: to accept an idea or change willingly
senses.pattern: embrace change / embrace new technology / embrace an idea / embrace the opportunity
senses.example: Older teachers at our school were quick to [[embrace]] the new online grading system.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校的資深老師很快就欣然接受新的線上評分系統。

senses.en: to include something as part of a whole
senses.pattern: embrace a wide range of / embrace many subjects / embrace several fields
senses.example: Her research [[embraces]] a wide range of topics, from ocean pollution to city planning.
senses.example_zh: 她的研究涵蓋廣泛的主題，從海洋汙染到都市規劃都有。
senses.note: 此義較正式

gsat.sentence: In response to rising demands, these hotels are [[embracing]] a wave of innovation. Instead of the traditional bare pod-sized style, new chains now feature interior design that appeals to digitally connected travelers from around the world.
We have completely [[embraced]] paper technology.

senses.en: known by almost everyone
senses.pattern: a household name / a household word / become a household name
senses.example: The young baker became a [[household]] name after winning a popular television cooking contest.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕烘焙師贏得熱門電視烹飪比賽後，成了家喻戶曉的人物。
senses.note: 只放名詞前，最常見 a household name

senses.en: without any real purpose, basis, or effect
senses.pattern: an idle threat / idle talk / idle gossip / idle curiosity
senses.example: The coach's warning was no [[idle]] threat; two players who skipped practice were removed from the team.
senses.example_zh: 教練的警告可不是空洞的威脅；兩名蹺掉練習的球員已被踢出球隊。

senses.en: (of an engine) to run slowly without moving the vehicle
senses.pattern: leave the engine idling / let the engine idle / an idling car / idle at a red light
senses.example: Drivers are asked not to leave their engines [[idling]] outside the school, since it pollutes the air.
senses.example_zh: 請駕駛人不要在學校外面讓引擎怠速空轉，因為這樣會污染空氣。

senses.en: secret information about an enemy; people who collect it
senses.pattern: gather intelligence / military intelligence / an intelligence agency / intelligence reports
senses.example: The general refused to attack until he had reliable [[intelligence]] about the enemy's position.
senses.example_zh: 將軍在取得敵軍位置的可靠情報之前，拒絕發動攻擊。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

senses.en: the general situation in a particular field
senses.pattern: the political landscape / the media landscape / change the landscape of
senses.example: Online shopping has completely changed the retail [[landscape]] over the past twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 過去二十年來，網路購物徹底改變了零售業的局面。

senses.en: to improve land by planting and shaping it
senses.pattern: landscape a garden / landscape the grounds / beautifully landscaped
senses.example: The school hired a designer to [[landscape]] the empty yard with trees and a small pond.
senses.example_zh: 學校請了一位設計師為空蕩蕩的庭院造景，種上樹木並設了一座小池塘。

senses.en: published writings on a particular subject
senses.pattern: the scientific literature / the literature on / a literature review / medical literature
senses.example: Before designing her experiment, she read all the available [[literature]] on sleep and memory.
senses.example_zh: 在設計實驗之前，她讀遍了所有關於睡眠與記憶的現有文獻。

senses.en: printed material giving information or advertising something
senses.pattern: sales literature / promotional literature / product literature
senses.example: The salesman handed me some [[literature]] describing the features and prices of the new washing machines.
senses.example_zh: 業務員遞給我一些介紹新款洗衣機功能與價格的宣傳印刷品。

senses.en: to invent a false story, excuse, or piece of evidence
senses.pattern: manufacture an excuse / manufacture evidence / manufacture a story
senses.example: He [[manufactured]] an excuse about a sick relative to avoid taking the math test.
senses.example_zh: 他捏造了親戚生病的藉口，以逃避數學考試。

senses.en: a widely believed idea that is not true
senses.pattern: a common myth / a popular myth / dispel a myth / the myth that
senses.example: It is a common [[myth]] that we use only ten percent of our brains.
senses.example_zh: 「人類只用了百分之十的大腦」是個常見的迷思。

senses.en: control of a place by a foreign army
senses.pattern: military occupation / under occupation / the occupation of the city
senses.example: During the [[occupation]], many families hid their food from the foreign soldiers.
senses.example_zh: 佔領期間，許多家庭把糧食藏起來，不讓外國士兵發現。

senses.en: the act of living in or using a place
senses.pattern: ready for occupation / the occupation of the building / in occupation
senses.example: The new dormitory will be ready for [[occupation]] by the start of the autumn term.
senses.example_zh: 新宿舍將在秋季學期開始前準備就緒，可供學生居住。

senses.en: to keep someone busy or fill their mind
senses.pattern: occupy oneself with / be occupied with / keep someone occupied
senses.example: During the long flight, the children [[occupied]] themselves with puzzles and picture books.
senses.example_zh: 在漫長的航程中，孩子們忙於玩拼圖和看繪本。
senses.note: be occupied with＝忙於…

senses.en: to hold a job, position, or rank
senses.pattern: occupy a position / occupy a post / occupy first place
senses.example: Ms. Wu [[occupied]] the post of school principal for twelve years before she retired last June.
senses.example_zh: 吳女士擔任校長一職十二年，直到去年六月才退休。

gsat.sentence: Although Russia does not [[occupy]] first place when it comes to alcohol consumption per capita, it is still close to the top.

senses.en: soon leaving a position of responsibility
senses.pattern: the outgoing president / the outgoing chairman / the outgoing principal
senses.example: At the ceremony, the [[outgoing]] principal handed the school flag to her successor.
senses.example_zh: 在典禮上，即將卸任的校長把校旗交給她的繼任者。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；反義 incoming

senses.en: going out of or away from a place
senses.pattern: outgoing mail / outgoing calls / outgoing flights / the outgoing tide
senses.example: All [[outgoing]] flights were delayed for hours because of the thick fog over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 由於機場上空濃霧瀰漫，所有離境的班機都延誤了好幾個小時。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；反義 incoming

gsat.sentence: The same strategy for docking a vessel during an incoming tide may not work during an [[outgoing]] tide.

senses.en: a way of expressing strong feelings or energy
senses.pattern: an outlet for stress / a creative outlet / an outlet for anger
senses.example: Painting gives the nurse a creative [[outlet]] for the stress she feels after long shifts.
senses.example_zh: 繪畫讓這位護理師在長時間輪班後，有個具創意的壓力發洩途徑。
senses.note: 介系詞用 for

senses.en: a place in a wall to connect electrical equipment
senses.pattern: an electrical outlet / a wall outlet / plug sth into an outlet
senses.example: My phone battery was almost dead, but every [[outlet]] in the waiting room was taken.
senses.example_zh: 我的手機快沒電了，但候車室裡每個電源插座都有人在用。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式稱 socket

senses.en: a company that publishes or broadcasts news
senses.pattern: a news outlet / media outlets / online outlets
senses.example: Several news [[outlets]] reported the earthquake within minutes, long before officials made a statement.
senses.example_zh: 數家新聞媒體在幾分鐘內就報導了這場地震，比官方發表聲明早得多。

senses.en: (of a feeling or idea) to take control of someone
senses.pattern: be possessed by fear / be possessed by a desire / What possessed you to do that?
senses.example: [[Possessed]] by a sudden fear, the boy dropped his flashlight and ran out of the cave.
senses.example_zh: 男孩被突如其來的恐懼所支配，丟下手電筒跑出了洞穴。
senses.note: What possessed you…? 表驚訝責問

senses.en: to make someone decide to do something
senses.pattern: prompt sb to do sth / prompt a response / prompt concern / prompt an investigation
senses.example: A series of accidents at the crossing [[prompted]] local parents to demand a new traffic light.
senses.example_zh: 路口接連發生事故，促使當地家長要求增設紅綠燈。

senses.en: a question or instruction telling someone what to write
senses.pattern: a writing prompt / an essay prompt / type a prompt / respond to the prompt
senses.example: Students were given a short [[prompt]] and thirty minutes to write a story based on it.
senses.example_zh: 學生拿到一段簡短的提示，並有三十分鐘可以據此寫出一篇故事。

gsat.sentence: Some scholars theorize that onions may have been used for the dead because it was believed that their strong scent would [[prompt]] the dead to breathe again.
RTRI’s new invention [[prompts]] deer to run away.

senses.en: to say firmly that something is true
senses.pattern: protest your innocence / protest that … / protest loudly that …
senses.example: The boy [[protested]] that he had never touched the vase, but nobody in the room believed him.
senses.example_zh: 那個男孩堅稱自己從沒碰過花瓶，但房間裡沒有人相信他。
senses.note: 常見於被人懷疑、指責時

senses.en: to continue to do an activity or study over time
senses.pattern: pursue a career in / pursue a degree / pursue further studies / pursue a hobby
senses.example: After high school, she moved to Vienna to [[pursue]] her studies in classical music.
senses.example_zh: 高中畢業後，她搬到維也納攻讀古典音樂。

senses.en: to continue to discuss or look into a matter
senses.pattern: pursue the matter / pursue the question / pursue a complaint / pursue the issue further
senses.example: Since the store agreed to give a full refund, we decided not to [[pursue]] the matter any further.
senses.example_zh: 既然商店同意全額退費，我們決定不再追究這件事。

gsat.sentence: Michael has decided to [[pursue]] a career in physics and has set his mind on becoming a professor.
Most young people in Taiwan are not satisfied with a high school diploma and continue to [[pursue]] further education in college.

senses.en: to think carefully and deeply about something
senses.pattern: reflect on / reflect on one's mistakes / time to reflect
senses.example: At the end of each semester, our teacher asks us to [[reflect]] on what we have learned.
senses.example_zh: 每學期結束時，老師都會要我們靜下心來深思這學期學到了什麼。
senses.note: 名詞 reflection：深思、反省

senses.en: to use something bad because nothing else works
senses.pattern: resort to violence / resort to lying / resort to force / resort to doing sth
senses.example: Even when you are angry, you should never [[resort]] to violence to settle an argument.
senses.example_zh: 即使在生氣的時候，也絕不該訴諸暴力來解決爭執。
senses.note: resort to＋名詞／V-ing，to 是介系詞

senses.en: a course of action used when others fail
senses.pattern: as a last resort / a measure of last resort / the only resort
senses.example: Surgery should be used only as a last [[resort]], after rest and medicine have both failed.
senses.example_zh: 只有在休息和藥物都無效之後，才應把手術當作最後的手段。
senses.note: as a last resort＝萬不得已時

gsat.sentence: Without a shared language, they often [[resort]] to smiling to get along with others.
Foggers, or bug bombs, should really be a measure of last [[resort]].

senses.en: to get something, especially after much effort
senses.pattern: secure a job / secure funding / secure a place / secure a victory
senses.example: After months of hard practice, the team finally [[secured]] a place in the national finals.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月苦練，這支隊伍終於爭取到全國決賽的席次。

senses.en: to fasten or fix something firmly
senses.pattern: secure a rope / secure the ladder / secure sth to / secure sth with
senses.example: The climbers [[secured]] the rope to a large rock before going down the cliff.
senses.example_zh: 攀岩者先把繩索繫牢在一塊大岩石上，才沿著懸崖下降。

gsat.sentence: Many animals are known to live and move in groups to [[secure]] food and avoid predators.
Prom night can be a dreadful experience for socially awkward teens or for those who do not [[secure]] dates.

senses.en: typical of and closely associated with someone
senses.pattern: a signature dish / a signature style / a signature song / a signature move
senses.example: The restaurant's [[signature]] dish is a spicy beef noodle soup that has been served since 1960.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳的招牌菜是從 1960 年賣到現在的麻辣牛肉麵。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前

senses.en: a distinctive quality that identifies something
senses.pattern: the signature of / a chemical signature / a clear signature of
senses.example: Bright colors and bold lines are the [[signature]] of this painter's early work.
senses.example_zh: 鮮豔的色彩和大膽的線條是這位畫家早期作品的特徵。

senses.en: to describe something briefly, without many details
senses.pattern: sketch out a plan / sketch out an idea / sketch the main points
senses.example: In the first meeting, the manager [[sketched]] out her plan for the year without going into detail.
senses.example_zh: 在第一次會議上，經理概述了她今年的計畫，並未深入細節。
senses.note: 名詞也可指「概述、梗概」

senses.en: a short funny scene performed in a show
senses.pattern: a comedy sketch / perform a sketch / write a sketch / a sketch show
senses.example: For the school talent show, our class performed a five-minute comedy [[sketch]] about a forgetful teacher.
senses.example_zh: 在學校才藝表演上，我們班演出了一齣五分鐘的幽默短劇，主角是一位健忘的老師。

senses.en: to treat someone rudely or without proper respect
senses.pattern: feel slighted / slight a guest / be slighted by
senses.example: She felt [[slighted]] when the host greeted everyone at the table except her.
senses.example_zh: 主人跟同桌的每個人打招呼，唯獨漏了她，讓她覺得受到怠慢。
senses.note: 亦作名詞：a slight on sb 對某人的怠慢

senses.en: small and thin in build
senses.pattern: a slight figure / of slight build / a slight young woman
senses.example: Despite her [[slight]] build, the gymnast was strong enough to lift her own weight with one arm.
senses.example_zh: 這位體操選手雖然身材瘦小，卻強壯得能單手撐起自己的體重。

senses.en: a supply of goods available for sale in a shop
senses.pattern: in stock / out of stock / while stocks last / a large stock of
senses.example: The red sneakers are out of [[stock]] now, but new ones will arrive next week.
senses.example_zh: 紅色運動鞋目前沒有存貨，不過下星期會進新貨。

senses.en: to keep a supply of something to sell or use
senses.pattern: stock a wide range of / be well stocked / stock up on / stock the shelves
senses.example: The corner shop [[stocks]] everything from fresh bread to bicycle tires.
senses.example_zh: 街角那家小店備有各種貨品，從新鮮麵包到腳踏車輪胎都買得到。

gsat.sentence: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost bare and the [[stock]] nearly gone.
But because the potatoes had to be peeled by hand, it was a time-consuming chore and potato chips were often out of [[stock]].

senses.en: very noticeable or unusual; attracting attention
senses.pattern: a striking difference / a striking contrast / a striking similarity / a striking feature
senses.example: There is a [[striking]] difference between the two brothers: one loves crowds, while the other avoids them.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟有個顯著的差異：一個喜歡人群，另一個則避之唯恐不及。
senses.note: 亦可形容外貌「出眾的」

gsat.sentence: Perhaps the most [[striking]] thing about MOOCs, many of which are being taught by professors at prestigious universities, is that they’re free.
Sax, a proponent of single-sex education, points out that keeping boys and girls separate in the classroom has yielded [[striking]] educational, social, and interpersonal benefits.

senses.en: almost or very nearly the thing described
senses.pattern: a virtual standstill / a virtual certainty / a virtual stranger / virtual silence
senses.example: The heavy snow brought traffic in the city to a [[virtual]] standstill for most of the day.
senses.example_zh: 這場大雪使市區交通幾乎陷入停擺，持續了大半天。
senses.note: 副詞 virtually＝幾乎、實際上

senses.en: to produce a result, profit, or crop
senses.pattern: yield results / yield a profit / yield a good harvest / yield benefits
senses.example: Three years of careful experiments finally [[yielded]] results that surprised the whole research team.
senses.example_zh: 三年的縝密實驗終於產生了令整個研究團隊驚訝的成果。

senses.en: the amount of crops or profit produced
senses.pattern: crop yields / a high yield / increase the yield / rice yield
senses.example: Scientists are developing new types of wheat that give higher [[yields]] with less water.
senses.example_zh: 科學家正在研發用水更少、產量卻更高的新品種小麥。

gsat.sentence: Yet, it has consistently [[yielded]] many of the world’s best distance runners.
Sax, a proponent of single-sex education, points out that keeping boys and girls separate in the classroom has [[yielded]] striking educational, social, and interpersonal benefits.

quiz.stem: The reporter lost her job after her editor discovered that she had ______ quotes from experts who did not even exist.
quiz.explain_zh: manufacture＝捏造。記者捏造根本不存在的專家說的話，因而被解僱。

quiz.stem: While some elderly villagers still prefer cash, most young shop owners have eagerly ______ mobile payment as a faster way to do business.
quiz.explain_zh: embrace＝欣然接受。年輕店主樂於採用行動支付來做生意。

quiz.stem: Unable to find new jobs after the factory closed, some workers had to ______ to borrowing money from relatives just to pay their rent.
quiz.explain_zh: resort＝不得已採取（resort to）。失業工人只好向親戚借錢付房租。

quiz.stem: Contrary to the popular ______ that goldfish forget everything within three seconds, experiments show that they can remember things for months.
quiz.explain_zh: myth＝迷思、錯誤觀念。金魚只有三秒記憶是迷思，實驗顯示牠們能記好幾個月。

quiz.stem: Having lived in a mountain village all her life, Grandma finds the idea of paying for everything with a phone completely ______.
quiz.explain_zh: alien＝陌生的。奶奶一輩子住在山村，覺得用手機付款的觀念十分陌生。

quiz.stem: A ______ feature of the new library is its huge glass roof, which catches every visitor's eye the moment they walk through the door.
quiz.explain_zh: striking＝引人注目的。新圖書館的玻璃屋頂讓人一進門就注意到。

quiz.stem: Doctors warn that staying up late night after night can seriously ______ your immune system, making it harder for the body to fight off infections.
quiz.explain_zh: compromise＝危及、損害。連續熬夜會損害免疫系統，使身體較難抵抗感染。

quiz.stem: For many teenagers, playing in a band provides a healthy ______ for the stress and anger that build up during exam season.
quiz.explain_zh: outlet＝（情緒的）發洩途徑。玩樂團讓青少年抒發考季累積的壓力與怒氣。

quiz.stem: Thanks to better seeds and a new watering system, the small farm ______ nearly twice as many tomatoes this year as it did last year.
quiz.explain_zh: yield＝出產、產生。換了種子和灌溉系統，農場今年出產的番茄幾乎翻倍。

quiz.stem: The sharp rise in dengue fever cases this summer has ______ the city government to spray every park and clear blocked drains.
quiz.explain_zh: prompt＝促使。登革熱病例暴增，促使市政府在公園噴藥並清理水溝。
